static_traits.name: 周一凡
static_traits.social_status: 在校与同伴建立联系困难，觉得同学和教授忽视自己的作品；有少数同学可交谈，但not愿分享not安与自卑
static_traits.medical_history: without类似问题经历；without既往心理治疗/咨询史；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 能清晰描述感受与情境，思路连贯；Low mood，倾向自我贬低与社会比较；对正向反馈持怀疑态度；配合度尚可

basic_info.main_problem: 我认为学校的人都觉得我have not天赋，这种想法正在影响我追求成为时装设计师的信心和动力。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings are hindering my passion for fashion design and affecting my academic performance.
growth_experiences: 开学初从外地搬到纽约并进入名校新环境，过渡压力大；课堂评审时常看到同学频繁获赞，而教授很少点评或关注自己的作品，感到“像是隐形的”；not足感自学期初开始并持续至今，几乎每天在上课与评审时反复出现；尝试忽视这些负面想法但难以压制，影响创作灵感与流程。

core_beliefs: 我have not天赋/I am not good enough
My value depends on others' evaluations

special_situations.event: In class critiques, classmates are frequently praised while the professor rarely notices or comments on my work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我得not到明确的表扬或关注，就说明我have not天赋、作品一文not值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively compares with classmates, lowers self-expectations, reduces speaking and exposure in reviews to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都觉得我not天赋，我是个笑话

special_situations.event: 偶尔收到来自课堂或网络的正面反馈与点赞
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果正面反馈not持续且not是来自权威，就not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将积极反馈解释为客套话或安慰话，迅速negate并忽略
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是出于礼貌，not是真心的

special_situations.event: At the start of the school term, moved alone to New York, entered a new environment at a prestigious school, and feels adaptation pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能很快证明自己，就not配待在这里
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 把注意力集中在他人的优势与自己的短板，避免向同伴透露not安以维持“体面”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家都比我强很多，我not够格

special_situations.event: 同伴在课堂上被老师重点点评与表扬
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: do not人的成功意味着我的失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 给自己贴上“not天赋”的标签，减少投入与尝试以避免再度受挫
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我根本not如他们，怎么努力也赶not上

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看见并被认可自己的才华，获得接纳与归属
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与羞辱，担心自己not配而被排斥
defense_goal: 通过先行自我贬低降低被他人negate的打击
保持情感与人际距离以避免暴露脆弱
negate积极反馈以维持心理一致性和可控感

object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻挑剔、忽视我的评判者（教授与同学）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in class critiques the teacher is silent or comments little on her work while classmates get praised
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把老师的沉默理解为negate，把同学的优秀等同于自己的失败（将内在Self-denialProjection到他人评价）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用肯定句描述他人想法（如“他们觉得我not天赋”），语气笃定但缺乏证据，回避具体事实核查。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当收到积极反馈或线上作品得到点赞时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为对方只是出于礼貌或安慰，正面评价not真实
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以轻描淡写和自嘲的语气negate积极信息，use“只是…而已/客套话”等表述。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请其关注自身进步、列举成就时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感到被要求证明价值，担心暴露not足而引发羞耻
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Turns to abstract comparison and analysis, reducing emotional vocabulary, with a calm and restrained tone, avoiding talking about experiences of shame and vulnerability.

manifestations: 独自在纽约生活，离开家人
在校难以与同伴建立连接，感觉“像是隐形的”
负面想法干扰创作流程与灵感，热情被削弱
outcomes: 对职业梦想的怀疑与动摇

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在他人面前拘谨，not愿暴露not安
对自身成就苛刻审视，难以接纳进步

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 把Self-doubt归因为“大家都觉得我not天赋”
将他人沉默解读为negate或轻视

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 把“名校/导师的表扬=价值”的标准not yet经消化地内化
以他人评价作为唯一自我评估依据

exception_events.target_problem: 在课程项目创作与截止期前，来访者通常因Self-doubt与害怕被负面评价而拖延、Insufficient motivation，作品难以推进。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在上一份项目中，来访者仍然完成了作品，尽管并not完全满意。
exception_events.reason: Clues: still chooses to complete tasks under pressure, showing sustained commitment and persistence.

exception_events.target_problem: 在接受他人评价时，来访者通常会忽视或negate积极反馈，进一步加重Self-doubt。
exception_events.unique_outcome: After posting a sketch online once, the client received positive comments and likes and briefly felt seen.
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同情境（线上陌生人评价）可能降低对熟人评判的Anxiety，更容易接纳积极反馈。

positive_force: 对时装设计具有明确的热情与长期目标
在Low mood时仍能完成项目，具备坚持与执行力
曾获得同伴或网络的正向反馈，存在可用外部资源
Willing to seek help and try new methods (proactively seeking counseling, willing to conduct reality testing)
具备一定自我观察能力，能识do not负性想法的影响
negative_force: Excessively relies on external evaluation to determine self-worth（寻求外部验证）
读心术、心理过滤、比较与despair等认知偏差显著
自信心not足，倾向自我贬低与贴标签
在社交中回避表达脆弱，难以获得支持
新城市/新学校的过渡压力持续，环境适应not足

target_behavior.behavior: 在课堂评审与创作任务中的Self-doubt与回避（减少发言、降低投入）
antecedent: 在发布或展示作品之前
target_behavior.core_reason: 新环境与名校比较引发的自我价值脆弱，伴随读心术与社会比较导致Self-efficacy降低与害怕被negate
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的羞耻与负面评价以暂时降低Anxiety，并通过Self-protection维持安全感
target_behavior.consequence: 学习Decreased drive、创作受阻、Academic performance affected，与同伴连接困难
